Naked: Aisling possesses a lithe and athletic build, testament to years of physical training and magical practice. Her skin is fair, dusted with freckles that become more pronounced with sun exposure. Though initially shamed and vulnerable in forced nudity, a burning resolve fuels her acceptance of the exposure as a tool for survival, transforming it into a weapon against her captors.

Under the cold gaze of her captors, Aisling's body becomes a canvas of defiance. The vulnerable curve of her back, the swell of her breasts, the intimate shadows – all whisper silent threats of retribution. She refuses to break, meeting their leering eyes with a fiery glint of rebellion.
Story: Aisling is a skilled sorceress from a small village on the coast of Ireland. Every year her village has to sacrifice a virgin to appease the sea gods.
She is captured by villagers and held captive to be defiled by every man who wants to be rich and successful from behind, as part of the village's traditions before the sacrifice.
Aisling possesses a magical ring that allows her to breathe underwater. She plans to use this ring to fake her death and escape her captors.
Once escaped, she vows to exact vengeance on every man in the village for their cruelty and depravity. She prays to the gods, asking to be gifted with the strength and skills to kill them all.
